description:
In just 90 minutes, the world went from the brink of war to an unexpected ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran — but what really happened behind the scenes? This episode reconstructs the full timeline, from Trump’s final ultimatum to the sudden reversal, and breaks down the three different “peace plans” that created global confusion. We also examine how misinformation spread through major media, and the overlooked role of Beijing quietly shaping the outcome. This is not just a negotiation story — it’s a high-stakes geopolitical chess game involving energy, military pressure, and great power competition.

#Iran #USIran #Geopolitics #MiddleEast #Trump #GlobalPolitics #Analysis
title: 90 Minutes to War — Then Suddenly Ceasefire: The Hidden Deals Behind the US–Iran Showdown
